blurb: Guests can choose from premium self-guided boat rentals for sandbar afternoons and back bay explorations, private captained experiences for sunset cruises, celebrations, and fishing, or join a membership boating program without ownership burdens. The business operates from Commodore Bay Marina in Avalon, NJ, providing access to the coastal boating lifestyle. They also offer BRIG rigid inflatable boats for ownership and premium floating docks with deep water access.
